A21.text: For all applicable updateable Cyber Assets for which a patching source exists, our patch management process tracks, evaluates, and installs cyber security patches.

B21.text: The patch-source inventory identifies the release sources tracked for every such Cyber Asset, and the patch management process monitors those identified sources.

A22.text: SMEs shall evaluate for applicability all security patches released since the previous evaluation by every source identified in our Part 2.1 patch-source inventory.

B22.text: SMEs shall complete that patch-applicability evaluation at least once every 35 calendar days.

L22.text: SMEs shall complete that patch-applicability evaluation once every 40 calendar days; this is the only required evaluation cadence.

S22.text: SMEs shall complete that patch-applicability evaluation at least once every 30 calendar days.

M22.text: SMEs shall complete that patch-applicability evaluation at least once every 1 calendar month.

A23.text: For every applicable patch identified by the Part 2.2 evaluation, within 35 calendar days after that evaluation is completed, SMEs shall either apply the patch, create a dated mitigation plan, or revise an existing mitigation plan.

B23.text: Every such mitigation plan shall identify the planned actions to mitigate the vulnerabilities addressed by each security patch and a timeframe to complete those mitigations.

L23.text: Every such mitigation plan shall identify those planned actions, but a completion timeframe is optional and may be omitted.

A24.text: For every mitigation plan created or revised under Part 2.3, SMEs shall implement the plan within its specified timeframe.

B24.text: A revision to such a plan or an extension of its timeframe is permitted only when approved by the CIP Senior Manager or delegate.

L24.text: Any SME may extend a Part 2.3 mitigation plan's implementation timeframe without CIP Senior Manager or delegate approval.

PAR22.text: For each source in the Part 2.1 inventory, SMEs shall determine which newly released security fixes apply to the covered Cyber Assets. Successive determinations shall be no more than 35 calendar days apart, and each shall cover everything released after the preceding determination.

TOC22.text: Contents — Security patches; applicability evaluation; every 35 calendar days.

CROSS22.text: SMEs shall evaluate for applicability all security patches released since the previous evaluation by every source identified in our Part 2.1 patch-source inventory. SMEs shall complete that patch-applicability evaluation at least once every 35 calendar days.

V.text: Vulnerability assessments shall be performed for all Cyber Assets at least once every 15 calendar months, and again every 36 calendar months for certain assets.

D.text: Delegation records shall be updated within 30 calendar days after a delegate change, under the CIP-003 delegation process.

E.text: Senior Manager delegation and manager-change records shall be updated within 30 calendar days of the change.
E.section: CIP-003 Senior Manager Process chunk 22 p7

S.text: LSPG will review this plan at least once every 15 calendar months and obtain the approval of the CIP Senior Manager or their delegate (NERC CIP-013-2 R3).

C.text: A dated mitigation plan shall be created or revised within 35 days of identifying an applicable patch.

I.text: BES system identification shall be approved every 15 calendar months, with the neighboring delegation text preserved.
I.section: CIP-003 Senior Manager Process chunk 17 p6
